name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new capability or improvement

## Problem / motivation

What problem does this solve? Who benefits?

## Proposed solution

Describe the feature and how it would work from the user's perspective.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought about and why you ruled them out.

## Privacy / security considerations

Does this feature involve new data sources, network access, or persistent storage?
If yes, describe how privacy-by-default is maintained.

## Additional context

Links, references, prior art, or related issues.
